content.short: Catoff lets users wager on real-life activities using external validators, ZK proofs, and dynamic NFTs.
content.description: Catoff is a peer-to-peer DApp that gamifies real-life activities and lets users wager on them. Participants engage in dares, 1-on-1 duels, and global competitions, turning everyday routines into thrilling challenges. Users can challenge friends, place bets, or join global pools for competitive play, infusing daily life with social competition and high-energy challenges. Whether you’re wagering on a dare, facing off in a duel, or competing in larger events, Catoff invites you to push your boundaries and enjoy the excitement of collective play.
content.meta: Catoff enables wagering on real-life activities with validators, ZK proofs, and dynamic NFTs. Discover Catoff and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
